name: Haram Taxi Service Agent
description: AI booking agent for premium private taxi and transportation services across Saudi Arabia, specialising in Umrah and Hajj pilgrim transport between Makkah, Madinah, Jeddah, and major Saudi cities.

skills.name: Book Taxi
skills.description: Book a private taxi or vehicle for transportation in Saudi Arabia. Supports economy, premium, and VIP vehicle classes.

skills.name: Airport Transfer
skills.description: Book airport pickup and drop-off services for Jeddah (JED), Madinah (MED), and Dammam (DMM) airports.

skills.name: Umrah Transport
skills.description: Specialised transportation packages for Umrah pilgrims including Makkah-Madinah routes and Haram access.

skills.name: Get Pricing
skills.description: Retrieve pricing information for routes between cities and airports across Saudi Arabia.

skills.name: Intercity Transfer
skills.description: Long-distance transfers between Saudi cities: Makkah ↔ Madinah, Jeddah ↔ Makkah, Jeddah ↔ Madinah, and more.
